items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Chambers, he was with Fletcher before me.

ctx.x: How could they get me there? I wasn't with Fletcher in '21. No, there's a mistake there someplace. '21.
'21, it says. Now, it could have been they made a mistake. It is possible it was Elmo Chambers.
It could have been. Chambers, Chambers. Chambers, he was with Fletcher before me.
